notes: FM unemploymentRate 16.2% (2010): FSM 2010 Census figure carried in the Economy of the Federated States of Micronesia infobox (Wikipedia) and originally from CIA World Factbook. World Bank has no SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS series for FSM; current CIA WFB edition no longer lists an unemployment rate for FSM, so the 2010 census value is the most recent authoritative estimate.
All other economic scalars already populated and verified: minimumWageEur 425 (FSM state minimum wages $1.25-$2.00/hr blended), costOfLivingIndex 25, internetPenetration 39.5.

MS minimumWageEur 800: Montserrat's Labour Advisory Board completed its first minimum-wage review and recommended EC$12.50/hour (Jan 2025, Montserrat Focus / local labour ministry announcement); as of mid-2026 formal gazetting is not confirmed (wage.is still lists 'no statutory minimum wage'). Converted at DB convention: EC$12.50 x 40 h x 4.33 wk = EC$2,166/month / exchangeRate 2.7 = ~EUR 802 -> 800. Flagged in notes as a recommended (pending-enactment) rate rather than an enacted one.

MS unemploymentRate 6.0: CIA World Factbook archive (2015 edition, geos/mh.html) 'Unemployment rate: 6% (1998 est.)' - the only official-style estimate ever published for Montserrat; no newer census/labor-force survey figure found. Old but sourced; kept over a derived guess.
MS internetPenetration 57.2: DataReportal Digital 2026 Montserrat - 2,491 internet users in October 2025 = 57.2% of population (Kepios/ITU methodology). Consistent with Internet Society Pulse (~55%).

NU minimumWageEur 620: Niue has no statutory national minimum wage law (lawgratis employment-law review; wage.is citing SPC Pacific Community statistics). Prevailing/indicative rate ~NZD 7.00/hour (SPC-sourced, 2025). Converted at DB convention: NZD 7.00 x 40 h x 4.33 wk = NZD 1,212/month / exchangeRate 1.964 = ~EUR 617 -> 620. Flagged as a prevailing-rate estimate, not an enacted statutory wage; far below anchor NZ (NZ$23.50/hr -> EUR 2200 in DB), consistent with Niue's aid-dependent micro-economy.
All other economic scalars already populated: costOfLivingIndex 88, unemploymentRate 5, internetPenetration 98.

NF Norfolk Island: no missing economic scalar fields. minimumWageEur 2600, costOfLivingIndex 110, unemploymentRate 10, internetPenetration 57.1 all already populated and plausible against the AU anchor (AU national minimum wage AUD 24.10/hr ~= EUR 2600/month at DB exchangeRate 1.62). No corrections required.
